name: rdma-core
description: The userspace components for the Linux Kernel's drivers/infiniband subsystem.
license: (GPL-2.0-only OR Linux-OpenIB) AND (GPL-2.0-only OR BSD-3-Clause) AND (GPL-2.0-only OR BSD-2-Clause) AND CC0-1.0 AND MIT

kernel-headers.description: Install the RDMA kernel UAPI headers from kernel-headers/rdma/ (rdma/hfi/hfi1_user.h and its transitive includes) for out-of-tree userspace consumers such as PSM2. The linux/ subtree is not installed.

neighbor-resolution.description: Build with internal Ethernet neighbor resolution (ENABLE_RESOLVE_NEIGH=ON), linking libnl-3/libnl-route-3. Upstream daemons (ibacm, iwpmd) are not packaged.
